Flat-LambdaCDM fit to real DESI DR1 combined BAO data (Om_m=0.2939, rd*h=101.94 Mpc, chi2/dof=1.27, 10 dof) via two independently-coded prediction methods (astropy FlatLambdaCDM vs from-scratch numpy/scipy.integrate.quad) that agree to <1e-4, cross-checked by an independent 141x141 brute-force grid search.
DESI DR1 (arXiv:2404.03002) quotes Om_m = 0.295 +/- 0.015 and rd*h = (101.8 +/- 1.3) Mpc from BAO alone, flat LCDM.
This run's independent fit (BAO-B-0001) agrees with DESI's published result (BAO-L-0001) to 0.07 sigma (Om_m) and 0.11 sigma (rd*h).
